name: Restaurante Y Pupuseria Dora
eyebrow: Family Salvadoran restaurant · Marion, North Carolina
tagline: Family-run Salvadoran and Mexican cooking on Rutherford Road.
about: Restaurante Y Pupuseria Dora is a family-run restaurant at 1020 Rutherford Road in Marion, serving Salvadoran dishes and some Mexican food.
Dine in or pick up in store.
